targets.words: The transaction read set (line 430, cols) names Trade Date. parse_trade_date (line 234) reads the MM/DD/YYYY or ISO cell and window_flows (docstring line 295) assigns the performance day from it. Source spelled as the file spells it.

No settlement column: the five transaction columns read (line 430) include none. comp-find -i 'symbol|ticker|security|settle|settlement' over the 3 cottonwood adapter files: 0 hits in 3 files. Inferred: none.
No action column among the five read (line 430). Transaction Type, the only type-carrying column there, could feed action (inferred, never the source). The Opal action enum is not in code.

The column carries the sixteen vendor transaction types (comment line 91). TYPE_CLASS (line 94) is the code's five-label class over those types, not the Opal closed enum. Reading the column as the Opal txn_type is inferred; the Opal enum is not ratified in code.

No security identifier among the five columns read (line 430). comp-find -i 'symbol|ticker|security|settle|settlement' over the 3 cottonwood adapter files: 0 hits in 3 files. comp-find -i 'cusip' over the same files: 0 hits. Nothing inferred.
No security name: comp-find 'asset_name|asset_desc|security_name' over the 3 cottonwood adapter files: 0 hits in 3 files. Nothing inferred.

No share-quantity column among the five read (line 430). comp-find -i 'quantity|units|price|custod' over the 3 cottonwood adapter files: 12 hits in 3 files, none a quantity or units column (the hits are the price-return schema fields, custodian_reported and the roster custodian field).
No transaction price column. holdings_price_return (schema line 134) is a computed return field written from holdings, never read from a transaction row. Nothing inferred.

Market Value is read on each transaction row (line 430) and used in the flow as WORD_SIGN times abs(Market Value) (line 337; docstring line 14). The code's transaction value is this column; the Opal amount is that value by the code's use.
No fee column read. fee_amount is null by design (FEE_RAIL_UNUSED, line 371; schema line 136). A fee-class row could carry the money column; inferred only, never a source.

The transaction rows carry no custodian column. The roster custodian (ROSTER_FIELDS, cottonwood_account_dim.py line 40) is a per-account value, not a transaction column. computed: inferred, method the firm constant FIRM (cottonwood_bd_account_return_daily.py line 69, from the registry row) or a join of the roster custodian by AccountID; not a source.

computed: inferred, method classify(Transaction Type) (line 247) through TYPE_CLASS (line 94) to a five-label class, with the sign from External Flow through WORD_SIGN (line 115). The seven-class Opal enum is not in code.
No per-transaction id among the five columns read (line 430). comp-find -i 'txn_id|transaction_id|trade_id' over the 3 cottonwood adapter files: 0 hits in 3 files. Nothing inferred.

computed: inferred, method the classify result (line 247): a type inside TYPE_CLASS gets its label and an unkeyed type is UNRESOLVED, counted and never signed (comment line 92). No coverage vocabulary for account_transaction is in code.

pattern_producer.words: derive(reader, accounts, start, end) reads every fact_transactions partition (lines 429 to 432) and builds the rows of the returns table. It is the copy target for the transaction read. The gold writer shape is run_day (line 554) and write_day (line 517), a guarded put of data.parquet and manifest.json under gold_prefix (line 480).

silver_source.words: reader.read_parquet('fact_transactions', p) (line 432) over the partitions listed at line 429. The table names are the ALLOWED_TABLES tuple (line 79). The reader builds the prefix from the registry row in _table_prefix (line 183). The bucket and prefix values are not copied here.

address.words: opal_naming.address('irpt','cottonwood','gold','account_transaction','date=2000-01-03') returned this uri at rc 0 (LOCAL python -I call, no AWS). The builder did not refuse. Registry probe: comp-find 'account_transaction' over infra/logic/registry: 0 hits in 17 files. The same probe for account_class_daily also gives 0 hits, so the registry names no gold table and the zero does not show a missing row.

emit_path.words: Touch-points for a third gold table for Cottonwood. (1) The Lambda infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/account-return-daily/handler.py runs run_day (adapter line 554) for the owed days and touches only the account_return_daily gold prefix (its line 10). (2) The adapter write_day (line 517) does one LIST and two puts under gold_prefix (line 480). (3) This Terraform root has exactly one PutObject statement (iam.tf lines 5-6, 81-82), on irpt/<firm>/gold/account_return_daily/* only; the ListBucket condition (line 95) is the same prefix. A new table prefix adds one ARN to that PutObject list, which widens the role's write set and needs the never-widen sign-off (CLAUDE.md section 5) naming the blast radius, or a new role. (4) The Cottonwood holdings-performance role (holdings-performance/iam.tf line 285) writes only its two gold prefixes. Class prefix in the code's view: cottonwood_report_reader.py line 28 says Cottonwood holds no account_class_daily gold table; comp-find -i 'account_class_daily' over the 8 adapter files: 1 hit (that line). Nothing edited.
